usageNotes: Returns the list of available status sub-endpoints for a QEMU VM (e.g. current, start, stop, reset, shutdown, suspend, resume, reboot) — useful for discovery but rarely needed directly since the sub-endpoint paths are fixed. Call this before navigating the status tree programmatically, or to confirm which lifecycle actions are exposed for a given VM. No privileges beyond 'all' are required, so any authenticated token can call it.

examples.summary: List status sub-endpoints for VM 105 on node pve1

tips: The returned 'subdir' values are the literal path segments appended to this URL to reach each status action (e.g. 'current', 'start', 'stop').
This is a directory index only — it carries no live VM state. Use get_nodes_node_qemu_vmid_status_current for power state, CPU, memory, and uptime.
Because permissions are 'user: all', this call succeeds even with a read-only API token, making it safe for health-check and discovery scripts.
